create_HMDB_dataset_train: create an HMDB-101 training dataset instance with video clips and labels for action recognition
create_HMDB_dataset_test: create an HMDB-101 test dataset instance with video clips for evaluating action recognition models
review_HMDB_init: review the HMDB class constructor to understand how it loads video filenames and labels from split files
summarize_HMDB_class: summarize the HMDB class which extends VideoDataset to load HMDB-101 action video data with configurable clip sampling
refactor_HMDB_paths: refactor the HMDB class to use configurable DATA_PATH and ANNO_PATH instead of hardcoded dataset directories
